title: Peer Session Series – 4: Building a Job-Ready Resume & LinkedIn Profile
summary: The Department of Computer Science conducted a peer-learning session on building a job-ready resume and LinkedIn profile. The session was led by Utkarsh Thakur from 6BScCS and focused on helping students understand how to present their academic qualifications, skills, projects, achievements, and experiences effectively for internship and placement opportunities. Participants were also introduced to the importance of maintaining a professional LinkedIn presence and developing their professional profile.
location: Bangalore Central Campus, CHRIST (Deemed to be University)

title: Peer Session Series – 4: From Data to Intelligence – An Introduction to AIML
summary: The session introduced students to the journey from data to intelligence and provided an introductory understanding of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Conducted by Sherly Lance H from 4BScCM, the session highlighted the importance of data in intelligent systems, pattern identification, and technology-driven decision-making. It helped participants gain awareness of AIML and its growing relevance in Computer Science.
location: Bangalore Central Campus, CHRIST (Deemed to be University)

title: Peer Session Series – 5: UI/UX Design
summary: The peer session on UI/UX Design, conducted by S Keerthana from 4BScCS, introduced students to the importance of designing digital experiences that are both functional and user-friendly. The session encouraged participants to understand the role of user needs, visual presentation, usability, and experience in creating effective digital interfaces.
location: Bangalore Central Campus, CHRIST (Deemed to be University)

title: Labyrinth – Fieldops (Sport Tournament)
summary: Labyrinth Fieldops was conducted as a sports tournament from 08 to 15 February 2026, providing students with an opportunity to participate in competitive sporting activities and develop teamwork, coordination, discipline, and sportsmanship. The tournament included mixed basketball, mixed volleyball, mixed tug of war, women’s kho-kho, women’s throwball, men’s cricket, and men’s football. Shreyas S and Gautham from 4BScCS were associated with the event.
location: Christ University Sports Ground, Bangalore Central Campus

title: Peer Session Series – 5: No More Formatting Frustration – Introduction to LaTeX
summary: The session introduced students to LaTeX as a tool for creating well-structured and professionally formatted documents. Conducted by M Ashica and Pavitra M from 4BScCM, the session focused on reducing difficulties associated with document formatting and increasing awareness of LaTeX for academic and technical documentation.
location: Bangalore Central Campus, CHRIST (Deemed to be University)
